answer: Because each terrace escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the island ledger records every share and the spiral audit makes public the split. Assembling that for 54 aliases means 54 times 6 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. A bond must be split across 6 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
